Priya (People Ops): Quick heads up — huge congrats to Kai! Promoted to Staff ML Engineer and baby girl arrived this weekend. :tada: :baby:
Leah: OMG!!! Congrats both!! Name?
Kai: Thanks y'all — we're calling her Ivy. Mom + baby doing great. Also still pinching myself about the promotion. :heart:
Carlos: Double congrats, Kai!! Drinks on me when you're back. :beer: :tada:
Maya: So overjoyed. People Ops — can we run a group card and gift?
Priya (People Ops): Yep, I'm creating a card now and collecting for a gift card. I'll DM payment details. Any gift ideas?
Sophia: Maybe a stroller fund + board book bundle? Or a small handmade blanket? :baby_bottle:
DevBot: automated reminder — add your reaction to contribute! Current reactions: :tada: x3
Ryan: Added to the card. Also proposing a celebratory cake at next Wed retro — Kai ok with that? :cake:
Kai: Love that — I'll be in on Wed and would love cake. Appreciate everyone so much. :smile:
Leah: Sending a virtual hug :hugging_face:
